scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.server: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p web && tsc -p worker
scripts.worker: npm run build -w web && npm run dev -w worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w web && npm run deploy -w worker
